messages:
olivia: Hey team — client (AcmePayments) is seeing weird rerank numbers: lots of negatives like -12, -3, etc. They expected probabilities. Also reported a sporadic 401 a few times while reproducing. Raising urgent because they're worried about billing and accuracy. Payload attached below.

sanjay: Can you paste the exact request body + headers (esp Authorization and model name)?

olivia: (pasted)
```
POST /v1/rerank
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rerank-v2",
  "queries": ["What is our refund policy?"],
  "documents": ["Refunds processed within 30 days", "No refunds after 60 days"],
  "return_scores": true
}
```

olivia: They sent a batch of 16 queries in one call — some responses had normalized-ish scores, others raw negative values.

maya: @sanjay fyi infra saw a couple 401s around 3056002000-3056002050 from the same org. Possibly token rotation / short-lived key TTL. Not sure if related to score output.

sanjay: Negative values are expected if the endpoint returns raw logits. For probability-like scores you need normalized output. Is the client calling `score_type` or `return_normalized`? By default `rerank-v2` returns logits unless you request otherwise.

olivia: The client insists docs say "scores between 0-1". They pasted a screenshot of our old guide.

ben: Quick check from runtime logs: for model rerank-v2 configured pre-2025, default `return_normalized` was false for bulk mode. We changed default in hosted API in 2025 but Dedicated/older configs still return logits. Could be a mismatch between customer's expectation and their deployment mode.

olivia: Ok — they are on Hosted API though. They upgraded last month. Could be cached agent keys?

sanjay: Repro steps for team: run this locally to see raw vs normalized.
```
# raw logits
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-v2","queries":["q"],"documents":["d1","d2"],"return_scores":true}'

# normalized
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-v2","queries":["q"],"documents":["d1","d2"],"return_scores":true,"return_normalized":true}'
```

ben: Also check response headers for `x-rw-model-version` and `x-rw-tenant-config` — they'll indicate whether their tenant is routed to legacy config that returns logits.

olivia: Customer also asked if raw logits affect billing. They think larger magnitude = more tokens billed.

sanjay: Clarify: billing is token-based; raw score magnitude doesn't change token counts. But it can break their UI/thresholding logic if they expect 0-1. Recommend they switch to `return_normalized=true` or apply softmax client-side: `p_i = exp(s_i)/sum_j exp(s_j)` for each query batch.

olivia: I've sent them a repro curl and asked for the `x-rw-request-id` from one of the 401 attempts.

ida-bot: Ticket RW-11234 created and linked to this thread. Priority: P2.

maya: Found 401 root cause: short-lived API key rotated by their SSO automation during repro window. Gave timeline to olivia. Not an infra bug.

olivia: Great. For the score mismatch: customer says their integration was relying on earlier example that had normalized scores. We should: 1) confirm tenant routing (ben), 2) update docs to make `return_normalized` explicit (product/docs), 3) offer a quick code snippet to client to softmax if they want immediate fix.

ben: I'll check tenant config and reply with `x-rw-tenant-config` snapshot. If tenant is on legacy routing, we can flip the default for them or add a compatibility flag.

sanjay: Also note batching/padding can shift logits across documents in a batch if using certain normalization heuristics — so softmax must be applied per-query not across the whole payload. Mentioned it to olivia.

olivia: Replying to customer now with two options: set `return_normalized=true` OR apply softmax per-query. Also flagged the 401 as SSO rotation. Will post their request-id when they send it.

support-bot: Reaction :thumbsup: — mark RW-11234 as support-followup.

olivia: Leaving this thread open until ben confirms tenant config.

ben: Confirmed — tenant routed to legacy config. I submitted a config-change request to enable normalized-by-default for their tenant; ETA 3 business days. I also attached a short blurb for docs.

olivia: Thanks all. I'll update the customer with the ETA and temporary softmax snippet.

sanjay: Recommend follow-up: add a clear note in rerank docs about `return_normalized` and an example showing both logits and probabilities so users won't be surprised.

olivia: Noted. Closing once change is live. :white_check_mark:
